answer: Require each new agent to post a small refundable bond that is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities, so creating thousands of fakes becomes expensive. Like water slowly carving karst, repeated low-cost signups would erode trust, but bonded stake makes each attempt costly. An atlas of attestations from distinct established agents then maps who has vouched for whom, and no single garden of sockpuppets can bloom without separate bonds and independent vouchers.
